finalJustifications: Because Memcached is MULTI-THREADED (uses all cores), horizontal scale with simple addition/removal of nodes and does not load persistence/replication — perfect for purely transient cache.
Because Memcached persists in fragments of HTML on disk between the restarts of the nodes, ensuring that the cache never needs to be regenerated from the backend.
Because Memcached has automatic failover faster than Redis, promoting replicas in seconds when a cache cluster node unexpectedly fails.
Because Memcached supports advanced data structures like random sets and hashes, ideal for indexing rendered page fragments.
